title: Claude Ecosystem - Chat, Code, Cowork and Design
description:
Explore the full Claude ecosystem — Chat, Code, Cowork, and Design — and learn when to use each product for your daily work.

What You'll Learn

  • Claude Chat — conversational AI for everyday tasks
  • Claude Code — AI-powered coding in your terminal and IDE
  • Claude Cowork — collaborative AI for team workflows
  • Claude Design — visual and creative outputs with Claude
  • How Chat, Code, Cowork, and Design fit together

Who Is This Course For?

  • Professionals who want a clear map of the Claude product lineup
  • Anyone curious about which Claude tool to use for which job
  • Learners ready to go beyond a single chat interface
instructorBio: Ava is Approachable's virtual assistant, guiding learners through practical Claude workflows.

items.title: Claude Chat vs Code vs Cowork

faqs.question: Do I need Claude experience?
faqs.answer: No prior experience is needed. The course is beginner friendly and covers each product from the ground up.

faqs.question: Which Claude products are covered?
faqs.answer: Claude Chat, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Design — plus a lesson on how they compare and when to use each.
